summary: Dying declaration reliability; medical condition for competency; High Court reversal of acquittal; prosecution burden beyond reasonable doubt; hostile witnesses; Section 34 IPC (common intention); Section 106 Evidence Act (burden of explanation); life sentence imposition; husband's liability absence of direct accusation; mother-in-law's role in arson; septicemia cause of death; FSL and post-mortem reports; Tehsildar-recorded dying declaration scrutiny.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code, 1860 s.34, s.498A, s.302, s.114, s.323, s.504
Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 s.161, s.209, s.313
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned judgment set aside; acquittal restored.
